patterns.note: A highly prominent, multi-tabbed search form is centrally positioned in the hero section, serving as the primary interaction point for all core services.
Content is organized into clear, grid-based card displays for various travel options (hotels, rentals, packages), maintaining a consistent visual structure across different sections.
A vibrant, high-contrast blue is consistently used for primary call-to-action buttons, links, and interactive elements, standing out against a predominantly white and light grey background.
The hero section's background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a sense of depth.
The main header navigation bar at the very top of the page remains sticky, fixing to the viewport after initial scroll to ensure constant access to global navigation.
Informational sections feature tabbed content (e.g., 'Top Hotels on Domestic Destinations') to organize and present large amounts of related data efficiently without overwhelming the user.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
Content sections reveal statically as they scroll into the viewport, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy without complex entrance animations.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page remains fixed to the top of the viewport after initial scroll, ensuring constant access to site navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings (Centra No2) for sections, and a more classic serif (Reckless XPD) for display text in the hero, contrasted with legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards, buttons, and input fields, creating a friendly but professional feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout content grids and sections, with a more airy feel in the hero area to emphasize the search form.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly functional and visually prominent multi-tabbed search form, which acts as the central interaction point, immediately guiding users to their primary task. This is combined with a clear, card-based information architecture that efficiently presents a vast array of travel options.
